subject: Re: Kickoff: Project Riverbed (DSelect-k for multi-task ranking)
body:
Riverbed status ahead of the readout.

Ranker A: DSelect-k selecting 2 of 6 experts matches the dense-gate baseline on all four task heads (largest delta 0.15% AUC, within noise) at 41% lower gate-side serving FLOPs per Bilal's rig. Offline parity milestone: met.

Ranker B is the tricky one and the risk to flag: with 8 experts and the same num_nonzeros=2 setting, training is sensitive to the gate's initialization — two of five seeds collapse to a single expert early and never recover. The paper's smoothness knobs help; what worked best is a brief dense warmup then annealing into sparse selection, which recovers 5/5 seeds but adds ~8% training time. Recommend we ship the warmup schedule as the default and document the trade-off rather than chase a cleverer init before June 15.

One ask: can the readout deck use the Riverbed name only? Easier for the LRB paper trail.

Wei
